weapon.d: If unit initiates combat or is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+4 to unit and inflicts penalty on foe's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = current bonus on each of foe's stats × 2 during combat. (Calculates each stat penalty independently; example: if foe has +7 bonus to Atk, inflicts Atk-14, for a net penalty of Atk-7.)

assist.d: Unit moves 1 space away from target ally. Ally moves to unit's previous space.

a.d:
At start of combat, if foe's HP = 100% or if【Penalty】is active on foe, grants Spd/Res+3 to unit during combat.
【Penalty】
All effects that last "on foe through its next action." Includes penalties inflicted by a skill like Panic or Threaten and negative status effects (preventing counterattacks, restricting movement, or the effects of a skill like Triangle Adept or Guard).
